title: Is TabPFN the Silver Bullet for Insurance Pricing?
abstract: arXiv:2605.22892v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modelling claim frequency and severity for non-life insurance pricing predominantly relies on generalised linear models (GLMs), with gradient-boosted machines as the leading machine learning alternative. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) present a fundamentally different inference paradigm. By pre-training on large collections of synthetic datasets, TFMs enable inference on new data through in-context learning, without any dataset-specific preprocessing, fitting, or hyperparameter tuning. This paper presents a first empirical evaluation of TabPFN for motor insurance pricing, benchmarking two versions of TabPFN against GLM and XGBoost on two publicly available motor third-party liability (MTPL) datasets. translated_title: TabPFN是保险定价的灵丹妙药吗？
translated_abstract: 非寿险定价中的索赔频率与索赔强度建模主要依赖于广义线性模型（GLM），而梯度提升机则是领先的机器学习替代方案。表格基础模型（TFM）提供了一种根本不同的推断范式：通过在大量合成数据集上进行预训练，TFM能够通过上下文学习（in-context learning）对新数据进行推断，无需任何针对特定数据集的预处理、拟合或超参数调优。本文首次对TabPFN在机动车保险定价中的表现进行了实证评估，在两个公开可用的机动车第三方责任险（MTPL）数据集上，将两个版本的TabPFN与GLM和XGBoost进行了基准比较。结果表明，TabPFN并不能始终如一地超越既有基线：在索赔频率预测上它落后于GLM，且其表现依赖于上下文训练集的规模；但在索赔强度预测上具有竞争力。
tldr: 本文首次实证评估了TabPFN在机动车保险定价中的表现，发现它并非“灵丹妙药”——在索赔频率预测上落后于GLM且表现依赖上下文训练集规模，仅在索赔强度预测上具有竞争力。
en_tdlr: This first empirical evaluation of TabPFN for motor insurance pricing shows it is not a silver bullet: it lags behind GLMs on claim frequency prediction while remaining competitive only on claim severity.
